// diagnostic L3103

Jet.AllowReason

This `#Allow` has no reason.

What

This `#Allow` has no reason.

Why

Every lint allowance records why the selected lint does not apply at this site.

Fix

Add the reason slot: `#Allow(Jet.LintName, "why this lint does not apply")`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.AllowReason: Tests/UILint/allow_reason.warn.

Warning: Jet.AllowReason: This `#Allow` has no reason.
  --> Tests/UILint/allow_reason.jet:1:13
    |
  1 | run: fn() { #Allow(Jet.FloatComparison) print("allow reason") }
    |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Every lint allowance records why the selected lint does not apply at this site.
 Fix: Add the reason slot: `#Allow(Jet.LintName, "why this lint does not apply")`.
